description: Controls the diagnostic logging output detail level for the Crusher Labs Observation Engine.

LOW_FIDELITY.label: Strategic
LOW_FIDELITY.description: Binary diagnostic states only (POSITIVE/NEGATIVE per zone).

MID_FIDELITY.label: Clinical
MID_FIDELITY.description: Numeric instrument outputs: PCR Ct values, absolute pathogen mass, trigger states.

HIGH_FIDELITY.label: Bioinformatic
HIGH_FIDELITY.description: Full raw data matrices including 4-kingdom log-ratio tables and individual host microflora tracking.
